answers.notes: We are a 14 technician electrical contractor. Average ticket $610 with 3 jobs per tech per day over 21 working days, 55% of leads book. Google and Angi cost $14,000 a month at about $58 per lead. Repeat customers give around 80 jobs a month. We sell a maintenance plan with 240 members at $25 a month and expect to double that in a year. Materials are 24% of revenue, vehicles cost $1,600 per van per month, insurance $2,400 a month, card fees 2.7%. Summer peak adds about 20% to demand. We plan to buy four new vans at $45,000 each and want to present a valuation to a private equity buyer.
